page.content:
The entrance to Lion Camel Cave is surrounded by a mountain of corpses picked clean of their skin, puddles of blood, and tendons hung from trees. The stench alone was enough to keep anyone from approaching.

page.overview:
What is Lion Camel Cave?

The entrance to Lion Camel Cave is surrounded by a mountain of corpses picked clean of their skin, puddles of blood, and tendons hung from trees. The stench alone was enough to keep anyone from approaching.
